source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_bp_v4_parallel_rebaseline.py tests/test_parallel_verification.py tests/test_verification_contract.py tests/test_bp_v4_parallel_probe.py

claims.claim: A separate BP-V4 rebaseline command accepts only the explicit worker sequence 4, 8, 12, 16. The historical BP-V4 v1 probe and canonical four-worker profile were not changed.

The rebaseline runner performs one canonical collection followed by the four profiles once in order, using the shared fixed pytest invocation with load distribution and zero worker restarts. Its versioned envelope binds the exact subject, toolchain, collection, and per-profile timing and outcome without a selection field.

The runner uses the existing fail-closed worker collection, isolation, process identity, structured observation, and bounded failure-diagnostic checks; pytest failures produce unsuccessful profile results.

The verification contract recognizes only the exact new command as full-suite measurement coverage requiring full_suite_reason, rejects malformed family invocations, and keeps the new and historical measurement families distinct.
Focused tests were added for command grammar, execution order, envelope binding, failure handling, timing neutrality, and verification-coverage relationships.
